original_reference: Bickel, P. J., Hammel, E. A., & O'Connell, J. W. (1975). Sex Bias in Graduate Admissions: Data from Berkeley. Science, 187(4175), 398-404.
description: UC Berkeley graduate admissions by department and applicant gender, 1973. 12 rows (6 departments × 2 genders). Columns: dept, applicant.gender, admit, reject, applications. Total applications: 4526.
